title: usage.md says the kb's own headless runs load project hooks with --setting-sources project,local, but they also pass disableAllHooks
goal: Found in the review of SP-qzip6qar, item ST-rwq2rkhg (Headless delegated claude -p sessions leave work rows backlog.py cost reads): kb/_self/usage.md names kb_ask.py and ql_research.py as passing the flag that loads project hooks, and also says they run with the hooks off (kbcommon.NO_HOOKS, disableAllHooks), so a reader does not take them as sessions whose work is measured.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kbcommon; hooks_off = "disableAllHooks" in " ".join(kbcommon.NO_HOOKS); text = open("kb/_self/usage.md").read(); para = [l for l in text.splitlines() if "kb's own headless runs pass" in l]; ok = bool(para) and (not hooks_off or any(("disableAllHooks" in l or "NO_HOOKS" in l or "no hook" in l) for l in para)); print(ok); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
